meta.name: pop-up-book-illustration
meta.description: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画，具备立体层次感、明亮温暖色调，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景

copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 当你要求生成插画时，会采用3D纸艺弹出书风格：打开的书本场景、纸质纹理、多层立体结构、明亮温暖配色（薄荷绿/天蓝/珊瑚橙/奶油黄），并可点缀柔和霓虹与科技元素。
howto.when: 当你需要具有纸艺质感、立体层次，或提到薄荷绿、天蓝、珊瑚橙等特定色调的插画时触发。

say.text: 画一张AI主题的弹出书插画
say.note: 自动加入薄荷绿、天蓝、霓虹光效等元素

say.text: 做一张教育知识树弹出书图
say.note: 套用珊瑚橙、奶油黄配色和折痕细节

say.text: 生成品牌产品展示的纸艺弹起书
say.note: 融合纸质纹理与科技元素

howto.what_en: When asked for an illustration, it produces a 3D paper pop-up book style: an open book scene, paper texture, multi-layer pop-up structure, bright warm colors (mint, sky blue, coral, cream), with optional soft neon and tech elements.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you request an illustration with paper-craft texture, layered depth, or specific tones like mint, sky blue, coral, etc.

say_en.text: Draw a pop-up book illustration about AI
say_en.note: Auto-adds mint, sky blue, neon accents

say_en.text: Create an educational knowledge-tree pop-up image
say_en.note: Applies coral, cream, and fold details

say_en.text: Generate a brand product pop-up book art
say_en.note: Combines paper texture with tech elements
